basic_details.job_title: NIPER Ahmedabad Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

A Master's degree in the listed life science, chemical science and allied fields, or a four-year engineering degree in the listed branches, is required. content_sections.heading: NIPER Ahmedabad Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research-Ahmedabad (NIPER-Ahmedabad)
Development of Electroactive and Anti-inflammatory Nanomaterial-Reinforced Hyaluronic Acid Hydrogels for Neuroregeneration in Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury (ICMR Project ID: EMDR/SG/16/2026-01-03197)
Initially 1 year; renewals for a maximum additional period of 2 years
₹56,000 per month plus HRA, as admissible
35 years as on the last date of application

content_sections.heading: About NIPER Ahmedabad
content_sections.text: NIPER-Ahmedabad is the institute issuing this notice. The post sits in its Department of Medical Device and is part of an ICMR-funded research project. The Principal Investigator is Dr. Akshay Srivastava, Professor, Department of Medical Device, NIPER Ahmedabad. The Co-Principal Investigators are Dr. Hemant Kumar, Associate Professor, and Dr. Suveen Kumar, Assistant Professor, both of NIPER Ahmedabad.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: One of the following, as printed in the notice: Minimum Post Graduate (Master) Degree in Lifesciences, chemical sciences and allied field (biochemistry, biotechnology, biomedical science, chemistry, polymer chemistry, medical device, pharmaceutics, or pharmacology etc.) OR a four-year graduate degree in chemical/mechanical/biomedical/material engineering Candidates who possess all, or at least five (5), of the following skills will be preferred: Polymer modification (Hyaluronic acid and collagen) and Cryogel/Hydrogel fabrication Nanomaterial (carbonaceous and metal) synthesis and characterization Detailed hydrogel characterization including rheology, conductivity and bioadhesion Primary cell isolation and cell line culture (co-culture of neuronal and inflammatory cells) Spinal cord slice culture mode and Animal model of spinal cord injury Biochemical analysis and evaluation of biomaterials Next generation sequencing (NGS) data analysis The notice gives the age as 35 years as on the last date of application. No age relaxation is mentioned in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is ₹56,000 per month plus HRA, as admissible. The notice puts the approximate total emoluments at ₹72,800 per month. The engagement is initially for a period of 1 year, subject to availability of fund. Renewals are possible for a maximum additional period of 2 years, subject to satisfactory performance each year, availability of funds, and co-terminus with the duration of the project. The position is purely temporary in nature and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIPER Ahmedabad Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Candidates apply only through the Google form at https://forms.gle/7uQXEAfMX9ct6UqR8 , on or before 09.12.2026. The notice says that applying through any other mode will not be entertained. The notice does not describe the form fields or any fee. Documents named in the notice: All original certificates and relevant documents, to be produced at the time of the selection process A copy of the submitted application (proof of application), attached with the documents during verification

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the further screening process / interview, which may be Online or Offline. The notice does not give the interview date, venue or the shortlisting criteria. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The selected candidate will be engaged purely on a temporary basis, and the position is co-terminus with the project. Candidates must produce all original certificates and relevant documents at the time of the selection process. Further communication is to be made at [email protected] .
